# Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.getsyntux.com/): syntux is the production-ready, generative UI library for the web.
- Installation: undefined
  - [Installation](https://docs.getsyntux.com/installation): Setup instructions for each framework.
  - [Next.js](https://docs.getsyntux.com/installation/next): Install and configure syntux for Next.js.
  - [React Router](https://docs.getsyntux.com/installation/react-router): Install and configure syntux for React Router / Remix.
  - [Astro](https://docs.getsyntux.com/installation/astro): Install and configure syntux for Astro.
- Usage: undefined
  - [Getting started](https://docs.getsyntux.com/usage/start): Build your first generative UI webapp.
  - [Reactivity](https://docs.getsyntux.com/usage/reactivity): Update the user interface, statically or dynamically, after generation.
  - [Advanced usage](https://docs.getsyntux.com/usage/advanced): How it works, optimizing token usage, and more.
- [API](https://docs.getsyntux.com/api): Properties, methods, CLI.
